recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-37665 unless a future issue changes the broader Search Currency or AuditEvent guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-37665 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked the Search Currency text to change from 'with the exception of the creation of Audit Event resources auditing the search itself' to 'with the possible exception of the creation of Audit Event resources auditing the search itself' because creating AuditEvent resources during a search is possible, not required.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit b27671c2b1000f7d2e2028d9aaf5ff5b7be472c9, 'Apply FHIR-37665', which changed source/search.html from 'with the exception' to 'with the possible exception'. The current source/search.html still has that wording, and source/hierarchy.xml lists search.html as the Search page under Exchanging with FHIR Search.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread records John Moehrke identifying the AuditEvent wording as too absolute and Gino Canessa agreeing to file FHIR-37665. FHIR-I minutes for 2022-07-25 record FHIR-37665 as Persuasive with an 11-0-0 motion. No contrary community or source evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current active Search page already says 'with the possible exception of the creation of Audit Event resources auditing the search itself', which matches the Jira resolution.
